head: iPhone 18e camera may get a square bump like the iPad Pro, leak says
dek: Design files seen by Engadget from a supply chain source show the iPhone 18e with an almost square camera bump of about 28 by 35 millimetres, holding one rear camera, the flash and a microphone. Apple hasn't confirmed any of it.
details: On the current iPhone 17e the round camera sits apart from the flash and microphone. The same files show the iPhone Air 2 with a second rear lens, reportedly ultra-wide, and a camera module that grows from 3.45 to 3.8 millimetres while the phone stays 5.6 millimetres thin. The iPhone 18e, iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 are expected next spring; MacRumors puts it at February or March 2027. Engadget notes the designs could still change.
where: Leak only; launch expected in spring 2027
means: If you're waiting for a cheaper iPhone, the 18e may look different from the 17e, but there's no word on a better camera yet.
